summary: A school district member expresses opposition to limiting or sunsetting the E-Rate program, emphasizing the importance of continued funding for providing internet access and network equipment to support digital learning and services.

claims.argument: Funding loss would be detrimental to districts financially.
claims.evidence_quote: Currently, I am a member of the BOE at Metamora CCSD #1. I strongly support continued funding for E-Rate program. Metamora CCSD#1 receives $50,000 from this program. These dollars directly help provide internet access and network equipment. Losing this funding would be highly detrimental.
